After seedMarket, initialized must be true.
Only a specific predefined address can change ceoAddress

After a successful call to DrugDealer(), the correct contract sets ceoAddress to msg.sender (preserving the same caller), whereas the buggy version sets it to the burn address, violating the invariant that ceoAddress equals the caller.
After a successful call to DrugDealer, ceoAddress must equal the caller; the bug sets it to a constant burn address regardless of caller, so the invariant fails for any non-burn caller.
After any call to DrugDealer() that does not revert, ceoAddress must equal the original caller; the bug sets ceoAddress to a constant burn address regardless of caller, violating this invariant.
